sections.Profile:
Playmatic's "Harem" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released in 1974, available in both single-player and four-player versions. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, five standup targets, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Original Theme, 1970s
